properties.description: Built 2026-10-21 (phase 7 PR 3, epoch:planned-p7-a-hub-on-one-machine), for a hub whose efforts span three to six designs and which is reached only through the --call door. compose_and_analyse takes `other_graph_ids` (several designs by graph_id) or `tracked_designs: true` (every design this one pins). Core: DesignGraph::compose_many (compose.rs) builds ONE combined graph in memory, this design unchanged and each other design under its own `{graph_id}::` namespace, runs detect_gaps and open_defects once over the whole, and attributes every finding to the SET of designs its ids belong to, giving each id in the form a reader opens ('<graph_id>:<id>' for another design, unprefixed for this one). MCP (service/composed.rs): served alone, each design must be one this design pins and is read from its committed export through tracked.rs's one pin resolution (read_document, the document only, no searchable design); on a registry, from its live store through other_design_named, inside the readable set; through a hub's address (view.rs composes_the_view), tracked_designs names every member of the view. Reply: designs_composed, read_from, design_names, composed (nodes, edges, skipped_edges per design), counts (total, by_design, by_pair, across, of_the_whole, pairs_composed), by_design, by_pair ('a×b'), across (3+ designs), of_the_whole (findings naming no node), not_composed (the tracked search's states: missing, unreadable, not_reached, nowhere, not_read; unreachable on a registry), composed_note, tracked_note when nothing is pinned, empty_because when nothing is found. Bounded by budget_chars (default 30,000): prose first, then only the finding lists are sampled (reply_budget::bound_reply_sampling_only); counts and the lists of what was composed stay whole. Nothing is written to any design or export, no git, no network. A call naming one other design (design or other_graph_id) answers exactly as before (budget_chars binds it only when given). LIMIT: designs composed under separate namespaces share no node, so a pair appears in by_pair only where a check reads both at once (for example closure_criterion_undeclared naming two members' Projects); computed links are phase 7 PR 4 (req:designs-are-shown-where-they-already-touch-before-anyone-declares-it).
properties.name: compose_and_analyse takes several designs at once (other_graph_ids, or tracked_designs for every design this one pins) and attributes each finding to one design, a pair, or more
